entities.name: Jolrael
entities.description: One of the oldest Zhalfirin mages on Dominaria, a reclusive woman who lives in the Mwonvuli Jungle.

entities.name: Mwonvuli Jungle
entities.description: Jungle where Jolrael lives, now part of the plane of Zhalfir.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: Self-contained plane that returned to the Multiverse in place of New Phyrexia.

entities.name: Ki'pamu
entities.description: Capital of Zhalfir with the royal houses of magic.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: Planeswalker who advised the Zhalfirin king, whom Jolrael revered most.

entities.name: Queen Yormeba
entities.description: Ruler of Zhalfir crowned by Teferi.

entities.name: Teferi's Isle
entities.description: Island where Teferi's time experiments phased everything out of the present.

entities.name: Mangara
entities.description: Mage who came to rule Zhalfir and whom Jolrael was manipulated into fighting.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: Urborg mage who manipulated Jolrael and was defeated in the war.

entities.name: Keldons
entities.description: Invaders of northern Jamuraa who started the Prophecy War.

entities.name: Prophecy War
entities.description: War begun when the Keldons invaded northern Jamuraa.

entities.name: Mirage War
entities.description: War begun after Jolrael was already centuries old.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: Continent Jolrael, Mangara and Kaervek traveled to.

events.summary: Scorned by her peers, Jolrael forsakes humanity and goes alone into the Mwonvuli.
events.quote: After enduring the taunts and imposed isolation of her peers, Jolrael forsook humanity

events.summary: Jolrael emerges to see Teferi return and crown Queen Yormeba, then goes back to the jungle.
events.quote: She stayed to watch Teferi crown Queen Yormeba ruler of the nation

events.summary: Teferi's experiments phase his isle out of the present; Jolrael meets Mangara and Kaervek there.
events.quote: everything on Teferi's Isle was phased out of the present

events.summary: Manipulated by Kaervek, Jolrael declares war on Mangara, then realizes the truth and attacks Kaervek at sea.
events.quote: She rebelled and attacked Kaervek while they were sailing in the Kukemssa Sea to Teferi's Isle

events.summary: Teferi sinks Kaervek's armada and sends a drake to rescue Jolrael; she retreats to the Mwonvuli after Kaervek loses.
events.quote: Though Teferi sank Kaervek's armada, he sent a drake to rescue Jolrael from the wreckage.

events.summary: Jolrael helps defend northern Jamuraa from the Keldons in the Prophecy War.
events.quote: Jolrael helped to defend the land, using her skills with the native beasts to gain an upper hand against Keldon raiders.

relations.note: manipulated her, then she attacked him
relations.quote: Kaervek was only using her to further his ambitions against Jamuraa.
of all the people she ever met, Jolrael revered Teferi the most
When the Keldons invaded northern Jamuraa, starting the Prophecy War
